purpose: A narrowly governed *proposed* replacement for a second GitHub human-code reviewer, never a waiver of independent runtime Risk veto/security checks.

candidates.extra_guard: Shared Current State/Task Catalog/Governance write path; enforce merge coordination and separate lock release
Synthetic kill test cannot certify production Kill Switch; preserve A5 latch, veto and chain
Personal financial files/credentials prohibited; flow-adjusted equity metrics remain unattested
No Binance accounts, TradingView automated data or unlicensed feeds; P07 evidence quarantined
Imported CSV cannot certify data license, source attestation or trading authority

approval_conditions: Separate specific Owner approval of this FIN-P24-WT-001 policy at exact HEAD/CI evidence before it can be merged
After policy is merged/postmerge audited, amend each of five existing Task Contracts explicitly to reference this policy and remove ONLY mandatory *second human GitHub reviewer* slot
Each amended PR must rerun required Governance and scoped CI at final changed HEAD; all risk/security/quality negative tests pass
Produce per-PR A5/A8/A10 factual evidence checklist with no impersonation or false independent reviewer signatures
Owner makes explicit PR-specific Human Gate naming PR, current HEAD, CI artifact/digest; no bulk approval inferred
Before and after merge, check affected paths, Main Fresh Guard, branch protection, locks, full repository Governance, postmerge Branch Hygiene and Linear
Stop exception if code or dependencies touch live brokers, external orders, credentials, Auth, production risk controls, provider authority or executable Kill Switch
